test_name: Orthogonal NGS panel plus ctDNA (KRAS G12R-specific ddPCR or comprehensive plasma NGS)
tissue_type: 10-20 mL whole blood (Streck or equivalent); archival FFPE acceptable for the orthogonal tissue NGS
rationale: Pan-RAS and RAS(ON) multi-selective programs (RMC-6236, RMC-7977 and the divarasib-class follow-ons) require allele-resolved KRAS G12X status at trial entry, and most central labs re-test the variant on plasma at screening regardless of the local report. G12R is biologically distinct from G12C and G12D: it is RAS-GTP-binding-deficient, so G12C-specific inhibitors (sotorasib, adagrasib) are not the relevant class. A second-platform call plus a baseline ctDNA reading anchors both eligibility and on-treatment monitoring.
tissue_required_estimate: 10-20 mL Streck whole blood for ctDNA; archival FFPE or matched tissue NGS for the orthogonal call
decision_gated: Pan-RAS / RAS(ON) inhibitor trials (RMC-6236 NCT05379985, RMC-7977 NCT06445062); G12C-specific agents are not the relevant class.

notes: Order the plasma ctDNA panel and a comprehensive tissue NGS panel together where feasible; this single workup also returns the co-mutation, KRAS-amp, and TMB-platform reads requested in adjacent rows.

rationale: NGS copy-number calls for CDKN2A homozygous deletion can be unreliable at low tumor purity, and p16 IHC is the orthogonal protein-level readout that confirms loss of function. Most CDK4/6-inhibitor trials in CDKN2A-altered tumors require p16-negative status or biallelic CDKN2A loss at enrollment, and the IHC is the assay the central labs run. A confirmed loss reads cleanly; a discordance (NGS-loss but IHC-retained) is a meaningful signal that the call may be subclonal or assay-driven.
tissue_required_estimate: archival FFPE; same block as the tumor NGS
decision_gated: CDK4/6-inhibitor eligibility (palbociclib, ribociclib, abemaciclib) and CDKN2A-loss-enriched trial arms.

test_name: CCND3 alteration-class refinement (amplification vs activating mutation vs fusion) via NGS plus FISH or copy-number array as needed
rationale: The user-supplied report says CCND3 alteration without specifying class, and that distinction matters: an amplification or activating mutation supports cyclin-D-axis dependency and CDK4/6 sensitivity, whereas a single passenger missense without copy gain has weaker mechanistic weight. Cyclin-D-degrader and selective CDK4 programs (PF-07220060, fadraciclib, INCB123667) typically gate on copy-number gain or known activating mutations. Refine the class before the board ranks CDK4/6-inhibitor strategy alongside CDKN2A loss.
tissue_required_estimate: archival FFPE; usually returnable from the same NGS panel as the KRAS / co-mutation row
decision_gated: CDK4/6-inhibitor and cyclin-D-degrader trial enrichment (PF-07220060, fadraciclib, INCB123667).

providers.name: Memorial Sloan Kettering Diagnostic Molecular Pathology

notes: If the underlying panel already returns copy-number plus variant class, this is a re-read of the existing report rather than a new order. Ask the molecular pathologist to annotate the alteration class explicitly.

test_name: Comprehensive tumor NGS including SMAD4, KEAP1, STK11, GNAS, ARID1A
tissue_type: archival FFPE preferred; ctDNA acceptable as a complement
rationale: SMAD4 loss in PDAC is the strongest single co-alteration linked to wider metastatic spread and shorter survival, and it changes how the board weights aggressive multi-agent regimens against trial enrollment. KEAP1 and STK11 are imported from the NSCLC literature for a reason: they predict diminished ICI benefit on KRAS-mutant backgrounds and would tilt any decision to layer pembrolizumab onto a pan-RAS inhibitor. GNAS and ARID1A refine the differential against IPMN-origin disease and ARID1A-defined synthetic-lethal pathways.
tissue_required_estimate: archival FFPE; ctDNA as a backup if tissue is exhausted
decision_gated: Frames prognosis under multi-agent therapy and weights any ICI-combo strategy on the KRAS axis.

providers.name: Memorial Sloan Kettering Diagnostic Molecular Pathology

notes: Almost every comprehensive panel covers these genes; the row exists so the board sees SMAD4 and KEAP1/STK11 status explicitly rather than burying them in a 500-gene appendix.

test_name: Germline hereditary-cancer panel covering BRCA1, BRCA2, PALB2, ATM, MLH1, MSH2, MSH6, PMS2, EPCAM, CDKN2A, TP53, STK11
rationale: NCCN guidance is that every patient with pancreatic adenocarcinoma should be offered germline testing regardless of family history. A pathogenic BRCA1/2 or PALB2 variant opens the platinum-plus-PARP-inhibitor pathway (olaparib maintenance is FDA-approved for germline BRCA-mutant metastatic PDAC after platinum). Lynch and Li-Fraumeni hits would change family screening and would not be excluded by a somatic-only tumor panel; CDKN2A germline is non-trivial in PDAC with melanoma family history (FAMMM).
tissue_required_estimate: 5-10 mL EDTA whole blood; saliva kits available from most providers
decision_gated: Olaparib maintenance after platinum for germline BRCA-mutant PDAC; family cascade testing; FAMMM-CDKN2A screening.

test_name: MMR IHC panel (MLH1, MSH2, MSH6, PMS2)
rationale: NGS-derived MSI calls have known false-negative cases at low tumor purity or when the panel uses fewer microsatellite loci. MMR IHC is the orthogonal protein-level confirmation and is the assay most ICI-trial central labs accept on its own. A confirmed MSS by both NGS and IHC closes the door cleanly on the tumor-agnostic pembrolizumab pathway and frees the board to focus the ICI discussion on combination strategies.
tissue_required_estimate: archival FFPE; same block as the tumor NGS
decision_gated: Confirms the MSS call; closes the door on tumor-agnostic pembrolizumab.

test_name: TMB assay platform and calling-pipeline confirmation (panel size, filters, harmonization with FDA-approved 10 mut/Mb threshold)
tissue_type: no new tissue required; documentation review of the NGS report
rationale: TMB values are sensitive to the panel size, the mutation-call filters, and whether synonymous variants are included. A 4.1 mut/Mb on a 500-gene panel may map differently against the FDA-approved tumor-agnostic pembrolizumab threshold than a whole-exome-derived value, and the harmonization study (Friends of Cancer Research TMB Project) shows non-trivial cross-platform spread. Confirming the platform and call pipeline locks in the sub-threshold call and forecloses the biomarker-agnostic pembrolizumab pathway cleanly. Below 10 mut/Mb, that route is off the table.
decision_gated: Confirms sub-threshold TMB and the foreclosure of tumor-agnostic pembrolizumab eligibility.

providers.name: Foundation Medicine
providers.notes: FoundationOne CDx is the FDA-approved companion diagnostic for the tumor-agnostic pembrolizumab TMB indication; reports TMB on a calibrated scale.

notes: If the existing report is from a CDx-validated platform (FoundationOne CDx in particular), this row is a documentation check rather than a new order. If the platform is unclear, ask for the bioinformatics methods section.

test_name: TP53 variant annotation (LOF vs dominant-negative vs gain-of-function) with reference to IARC TP53 database
rationale: The user report says inactivating mutation, but TP53 alterations split functionally into pure loss-of-function (truncations, splice), dominant-negative missense (hotspot R175H, R248W, R273H), and gain-of-function variants. Any TP53-restoration or mutant-p53 reactivation strategy (eprenetapopt / APR-246-class agents, MDM2 inhibitors in TP53-wildtype residual context) gates on the precise variant class. Annotate against IARC TP53 to make this explicit rather than re-litigating it at the trial-screening step.
turnaround_estimate: same-day re-read of existing NGS report
tissue_required_estimate: no new tissue required; re-read the existing NGS report
decision_gated: Frames any TP53-restoration or MDM2-inhibitor strategy; does not gate the KRAS axis.

providers.name: Memorial Sloan Kettering Diagnostic Molecular Pathology
providers.notes: Academic molecular pathology routinely annotates TP53 variants against IARC; the read is included in the report rather than as a separate order.

notes: Most likely returnable as an annotation re-read of the existing NGS report. If the local pathology report only says inactivating without specifying the codon and class, ask for the variant call in HGVS notation.

test_name: p16 IHC across multiple tumor regions (primary site vs metastatic biopsy if available)
tissue_type: archival FFPE from more than one site
rationale: PDAC biology often shows clonal heterogeneity between primary and metastatic sites, and CDKN2A loss is not always uniform. A patchy p16 result on multi-region IHC tempers expectations for CDK4/6-inhibitor monotherapy and may push the board toward combination strategies. Lower priority than the orthogonal IHC because the gating decision rides on the dominant block, but the heterogeneity read changes how the response is interpreted.
tissue_required_estimate: archival FFPE from a second site if available
decision_gated: Refines confidence in the CDKN2A loss call for CDK4/6-inhibitor strategy; does not gate enrollment.

test_name: Serial KRAS G12R ctDNA quantitation (ddPCR or tumor-informed MRD) at baseline and at cycle 2 / cycle 4 of KRAS-directed therapy
tissue_type: 10 mL Streck whole blood per draw
rationale: On KRAS-directed therapy, the rate of KRAS variant-allele-fraction decline by cycle 2 to cycle 4 is one of the earliest readouts of biological response and tracks ahead of RECIST imaging by weeks. A rising VAF on therapy is a sentinel for emerging resistance and prompts an earlier re-biopsy or re-staging conversation. Does not gate enrollment; informs how the team sequences imaging, re-biopsy, and switch decisions while on a pan-RAS inhibitor.
tissue_required_estimate: 10 mL Streck whole blood per draw; serial sampling protocol
decision_gated: Early-response and emerging-resistance surveillance on pan-RAS / RAS(ON) inhibitor therapy.

providers.notes: Tumor-informed MRD is the most quantitative monitoring option when a baseline tumor block is available.

providers.name: Bio-Rad / academic ddPCR core
providers.notes: Most academic molecular-pathology cores run a KRAS G12X ddPCR assay locally with faster turnaround than send-out panels.

notes: Coordinate the serial draw schedule with the treating clinic so the cycle-2 and cycle-4 samples land at consistent calendar points; otherwise the VAF trend is hard to interpret.

test_name: Tumor NGS for KRAS copy-number (KRAS amplification, wildtype KRAS amplification, secondary KRAS mutations)
rationale: Baseline KRAS amplification and acquired wildtype-KRAS amplification are documented resistance mechanisms to KRAS-directed therapy, including the pan-RAS class. Detecting a baseline amplicon shifts the durability expectation; detecting an emerging wildtype-allele amplification on progression reframes whether the next move is intra-class (different RAS-directed agent) or a switch to chemo or to a downstream pathway. The same NGS panel that returns the co-mutation profile should annotate these copy-number calls.
tissue_required_estimate: archival FFPE at baseline; ctDNA at progression
decision_gated: Frames durability and next-line planning for pan-RAS / RAS(ON) inhibitor therapy; does not gate enrollment.

providers.name: Memorial Sloan Kettering Diagnostic Molecular Pathology

notes: Often part of the same panel run for the KRAS orthogonal NGS and co-mutation rows; deduplicate at order entry and ask the molecular pathologist to call KRAS copy-number explicitly.

test_name: Tumor microenvironment workup: PD-L1 IHC (22C3), CD3 / CD8 TIL density, and stromal density (alpha-SMA or H and E review)
rationale: PDAC is the textbook immune-cold, stromally dense tumor, and the MSS / sub-threshold-TMB combination forecloses the easy ICI route. The microenvironment workup informs whether an ICI-combination strategy (CXCR4 antagonist plus PD-1, KRAS-inhibitor plus PD-1, vaccine plus PD-1) is biologically rational for this case or whether the dominant problem is exclusion of T cells from the tumor bed. A PD-L1 CPS read also feeds any ICI-combination trial that uses a soft enrichment threshold rather than a hard cutoff.
tissue_required_estimate: archival FFPE; same block as the tumor NGS
decision_gated: Frames ICI-combination strategy (KRAS-inhibitor plus PD-1, CXCR4 antagonist plus PD-1, vaccine plus PD-1); does not gate enrollment.

providers.notes: MultiOmyx multiplex IHC can return PD-L1, CD3, CD8, and stromal markers on a single section.
